Frozen inputs re-hashed: all task and rules files listed in manifest.json match (0 mismatches). Re-derived each row-49 fact from the frozen bytes (staged-task-contract.md 'Cross-file agreements' table; quality-checks.md #49; workbook Quality Checks row 49 and Internal Quality Checks row 49).

Seed literals quoted in criteria all re-derived from seed_data.json: Platform Engineer Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz; Noor's note text; 120 messages in APP-101 (app_context.md:29-30); Lena unread 1 (APP-301: 3 messages, read_count 2, third from USR-REC3); Noor PE Infrastructure Interviewing, PD Design Application received; Tomas Data Analyst Finance Systems In review; Product Designer manager Yuki Tanaka; Data Analyst manager Bill Okafor; candidate wording table hireops_rules.md:190-197 = seed candidate_status_labels; page size 30 (rules:150-151, seed thread_page_size, hro_long_thread); places 1-50 vs tests 0/51/2.5; 15 s (instruction.md:5, rules:122, prompts 15000 ms); statuses 401/403/404/409 match rules:22-24,79-80. Judge: task.toml:30-35 is exactly the frozen [verifier.env] block (claude-code, z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx, OpenRouter); all five judge.toml use the judge='claude-code' fallback with no model/effort/temperature/weight. Scoring: tests/scoring.toml and tools/score.py are byte-identical to the template (render/constraints 0.0, 0.6/0.2/0.2, functional floor 0.05). Restart helper: test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER; scored/functional/judge.toml verifier server args ['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py','$APP_RESTART_HELPER']; functional prompt.md:1 and hro_intake_restart use restart_app once; no other dimension declares or uses it. Quoted counts: task.toml description/provenance quote no criterion count; functional judge.toml:23 comment '61 in all' = re-derived weight sum 61.0 over 12 criteria; weight-scheme comments (1.0/1.5/2.0; visual Likert equal) agree with polish 2,2,2,1.5,2, gates 1, visual 5x1. The literal 'lowest score (Likert 1)' / 'raw Likert1 normalizes to zero' agrees with the 1-5 anchors in visual judge.toml. Timed-observation and global-gate paragraphs are byte-identical between functional and polish prompts (gate also identical in visual). Budgets agree: gates 600+600<1500, functional 12x700 + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10200 < 11100, 1500+11100 < 13200. Lessons file checked against this row: lesson 13 (only localhost/127.0.0.1 addresses in every prompt, app_context and test.sh - confirmed), lesson 8 (modifier-hold wording present once in app_context and inherited by all prompts), lessons 7/14 (timed void/repeat rule identical in both prompts that use it), lesson 2 (one documented weight scheme, stated consistently), lesson 10 (largest raw prompt 8.6 KB; assembled per-criterion prompt far under 128 KB).
DRIFT (one defect found): the seeded literal 'Lena's count is 1' in scored/functional/judge.toml hro_unread_seen ('the starting read markers give her 1. No other session opens Lena's conversation') depends on a reservation of Lena Fischer's conversation that is stated in scored/polish/prompt.md:24 ('Never use Lena Fischer's conversation') but is absent from the functional prompt's Shared state section (scored/functional/prompt.md:21) and is contradicted in the same functional judge.toml by hro_readonly_roles, which tells the judge, as Rafael, to perform 'one conversation read (open any conversation) and one message send (a suffixed message in that conversation)'. Criteria run individually; hro_readonly_roles precedes hro_unread_seen in file order and the prompt says other sessions run before and after, so a staff send into APP-301 there raises Lena's true unread count to 2 before hro_unread_seen reads it. The reservation fact therefore does not agree across the files and criteria that act on it. All other cross-file facts agree. Source-level review only; no runtime or judge run was needed or performed for this row, and none is claimed.
counterexample: A fully correct app whose Conversations list puts Lena Fischer's Product Designer conversation first (for example sorted by job title then candidate, or by oldest activity) leads the hro_readonly_roles session to 'open any conversation' = Lena's and send a suffixed message there as Rafael, exactly as that criterion permits. Lena's correct unread count becomes 2; the later hro_unread_seen session reads 2 against its bar 'Lena's count is 1' and fails a correct app (3.5 of 61 functional weight). A broken app gains nothing from this, so the effect is a false fail only. The golden's most-recent-first list (threads.js:38) makes this unlikely for the golden, but not impossible.
suggested_fix: Reserve Lena Fischer's conversation in the functional prompt's Shared state section (never open, send in or otherwise use it except in hro_unread_seen), make hro_readonly_roles name the conversation it reads and sends in (e.g. Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation), and reword hro_unread_seen's 'No other session opens' to 'No other session sends in'.
